Dialog.Open.Title: Open database
Dialog.Open.PathHint: A B-Tree database is a file, an LSM database is a folder. The buttons pick either.
Dialog.Open.ColourHint: The colour marks the tabs of this connection, so it is visible where a query will go.
Dialog.Open.NotFound: There is no file at this path. To start a new database, use Create database.
Dialog.Open.NotADatabaseFolder: There is no WitDatabase in this folder: no manifest and no SSTable.
Dialog.Open.WrongPassword: Could not decrypt: wrong password, or the file is damaged.
Dialog.Create.Title: Create database
Dialog.Create.PasswordHint: A password cannot be recovered: the key is derived from it and no copy is kept anywhere.
Dialog.Create.BTreeHint: One file. Reads well and behaves evenly under a mixed load.
Dialog.Create.LsmHint: A folder of SSTables. For a stream of inserts into tables with no secondary index.
Dialog.Create.InMemoryHint: Disappears when the connection closes. For trying things out.
Dialog.Create.InMemoryWarning: The data will disappear when the connection closes. The only way to keep it is to export it.
Dialog.Create.FileHint: B-Tree was chosen, so a file is asked for.
Dialog.Create.FolderHint: LSM was chosen, so an empty folder is asked for.
Dialog.Create.PasswordsDiffer: The two passwords are not the same.
Language.Name: English
